rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an archaeological or historically important object.

example.english: The museum displayed an artifact excavated from the site.
example.traditional: 博物館展出咗一件喺遺址掘出嚟嘅文物。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 ceot1 zo2 jat1 gin6 hai2 wai4 zi2 gwat6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 man4 mat6

rows.note: Use this for an apparent feature produced by an experiment or test rather than by the thing itself.

example.english: This result is only an artifact of the experiment, not a feature of the sample itself.
example.traditional: 呢個結果只係實驗造成嘅假象，唔係樣本本身嘅特徵。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 zi2 hai6 sat6 jim6 zou6 sing4 ge3 gaa2 zoeng6 m4 hai6 joeng6 bun2 bun2 san1 ge3 dak6 zing1

rows.note: Use this technical term specifically for a false mark or feature on an X-ray or other medical image.

example.english: The radiologist said the spot on the image was an artifact, not a lesion.
example.traditional: 放射科醫生話片上面嗰點係偽影，唔係病灶。
